## 19. Receipts, coverage, rollback, and completion

### 19.1 Evidence states

Use one of these precise states per object/test:

~~~text
NOT_INSPECTED
READ_ONLY_INVENTORIED
PREPARED
SAVED
READ_BACK
LOAD_METADATA_OBSERVED
MANUAL_READ_ONLY
UNKNOWN_OUTCOME
FRESH_BEHAVIOR_OBSERVED
AUDIO_HEARD
FAILED
PENDING_DEVICE_ACCESS
PENDING_USER_SAVE
BLOCKED_APPROVAL
UNSUPPORTED_AUTOMATION_ROUTE
UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
NOT_APPLICABLE
~~~

These states are not a linear ladder that every object must traverse. A setting may be read back while audio remains untested. Manual file access is not startup loading. Behavior can be observed without the product exposing instruction metadata; describe both honestly.

### 19.2 Operation receipt template

~~~json
{
  "receipt_version": 1,
  "spec_id": "LUCIFER-2026-10-24-R1",
  "canonical_sha256": null,
  "executed_at": null,
  "executor": {
    "product": null, "version": null, "model_observed": null,
    "effort_observed": null, "host": null, "orchestration": null
  },
  "object": {
    "surface": null, "account_or_host": null, "path_or_id": null,
    "scope": null, "supported_operation": null
  },
  "before": {"sha256": null, "backup_path": null, "read_at": null},
  "after": {
    "sha256": null, "characters": null, "write_receipt": null,
    "readback_evidence": null, "load_evidence": null
  },
  "state": "NOT_INSPECTED",
  "preserved_unrelated_rules": [],
  "tests": [],
  "audio": {"heard": false, "device": null, "mode": null, "observer": null},
  "limitations": [],
  "required_next_action": null,
  "rollback": {"method": null, "precondition": null}
}
~~~

Do not fill unknown fields with plausible values. A real receipt can be a supported operation ID, retrieved object, local diff/hash/readback, user-supplied saved-field view, or dated observed behavior. Record its actual evidentiary strength.

### 19.3 Target coverage ledger

Create one row for each actually used target:

~~~text
Windows ordinary Chat text
Android ordinary Chat text
Chosen private Project text
Chosen private Project Live voice on Windows
Chosen private Project Live voice on Android
Other voice modes actually used
Windows Work/Codex local
Cloud Work if used
WSL/SSH/IDE Codex hosts if used
Existing Morning Light task conversation
Existing Morning Light call
User-facing subagent handoff
Existing custom GPTs/other projects if actually used
~~~

For each: instruction source, saved/readback state, fresh behavior cases, audio status if relevant, and unresolved blocker. Exclude not-applicable targets from a denominator only with a stated reason. Untested targets are not passes. A universal “all agents configured” claim is allowed only within a named tested scope, never as a promise about all future models or conversations.

### 19.4 Rollback

For a managed file block, restore only that contribution if the current block still matches the installed hash. If later user edits exist, do a three-way merge or ask about the concrete conflict; do not overwrite later work.

For a native setting, restore the backed-up value only through the same supported route and only if restoring it does not erase intervening edits. Keep unrelated current fields.

For memory, use the actual supported update/delete mechanism and report any inability to verify deletion. Do not reset all memory or the dot. Stopping the persona in conversation is a behavior change, not proof of erasing historical records.

For an optional trial, stop/remove only the service, files, and permissions introduced by that trial, preserving user's prior installations. Do not revoke unrelated credentials, delete prior repositories, or uninstall native ChatGPT.

### 19.5 Completion conditions

The future installer may report an installation cycle complete only after:

- reachable relevant instructions have an inventory and open gaps;
- active same-scope conflicts have a recorded resolution;
- supported authorized changes are actually applied and read back;
- critical fresh-session checks on accessible target consumers have actual results;
- acoustic claims are backed by heard audio, or explicitly remain unverified;
- unmodified/unavailable consumers have precise next actions;
- canonical/adapters/receipts are saved in the selected private durable location;
- any approval gate identifies the exact prepared action and why it is necessary.

If native UI automation is prohibited and no supported direct setting operation exists, the correct result is a concrete partially applied deployment with PENDING_USER_SAVE for that native field. Do not wait to prepare the payload until after asking. Do not call the result universal installation.

Respect Misha's requested output form. For the present authoring request, deliver only this one file. For a future install, provide a concise exact coverage report unless he requests file-only output again; avoid dumping every internal source, test log, or implementation detail into ordinary conversation.
